It was found that Ta significantly improves the creep resistance only if the ageing treatment is carried out to develop fully the size and volume fraction of the 7' precipitates.
However, the addition of Ta significantly improves the creep resistance compared with the commercial alloys without Ta.

Comparing the two commercial alloys, one can see that Nimonic 80A exhibits better creep resistance than that of Waspaloy at any temperature under any stress, which implies that the replacement of Ni by Co and Mo has a negative effect on the creep strength.
